name: Political instability
value: No G20 collapse; Indonesia VP vote 11 Dec
summary: Indonesia's assembly moves its vice-president vote to 11 Dec; Prabowo names two nominees; no G20 collapse or coup
state: Indonesia's People's Consultative Assembly moved the session to elect a successor to Vice-President Gibran from 9 to 11 Dec to meet its 14-working-day nomination rule (Antara, 23 Nov). On 23 Nov President Prabowo nominated ministers Andi Amran Sulaiman and Sugiono as candidates (Kompas). The process follows the constitution. Searches on 24 Nov found no G20 government collapse, contested election or coup in the past month, so the level stays Normal.
for_you: No direct effect on most readers. Political transitions handled through constitutional processes rarely disrupt travel or trade.
rubric_hit: Normal: no G20 government collapse, contested election or coup in the past month; Indonesia's VP succession follows constitutional process

sources.title: Antara — Parliament reschedules vice presidential election to December 11
Kompas — Prabowo proposes Amran Sulaiman and Sugiono as replacement vice-presidential candidates

why: Coups, contested elections and constitutional crises in large economies unsettle markets, alliances and policy.
drivers: Elections, government collapses, coups, emergency rule, mass protest movements.

rubric.alert: Coup or constitutional crisis in a G20 country, or deadly unrest threatening a G20 government.
rubric.watch: Government collapse or contested election in a G20 country, or a coup anywhere.
rubric.normal: No G20 government collapse, contested election or coup in the past month.
